department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

benefits: Income support paid through DBT in eligible installments

eligibility.land_size: As defined by the scheme rules

department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Crop insurance support against notified crop losses and risks under state-notified areas and seasons.
benefits: Insurance cover for notified crops and risks
Claim settlement according to scheme rules

other_conditions: Crop, area and season must be notified

application_process: Check notified crops and cut-off dates
Apply through the official portal, bank, CSC or authorised channel

department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Improves irrigation coverage and water-use efficiency through state and component programmes.
benefits: Support depends on the notified component and state programme
Water-use efficiency and irrigation infrastructure support

other_conditions: State department implementation and approved component apply

application_process: Contact the state agriculture or horticulture department for the active component

department: Department of Financial Services and Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Institutional short-term credit facility for cultivation and related agricultural needs.
benefits: Access to crop loan and working capital subject to lender appraisal
Flexible agricultural credit within sanctioned limits

eligibility.land_size: Lender and crop scale rules apply
other_conditions: Bank appraisal and documentation are required

application_process: Apply at a participating bank or use the official scheme information page

department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

application_process: Use the official portal or contact the local agriculture department for soil sampling

department: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
